summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange overseas regulatory announcement dated 24 September 2026 covering a routine employee share-option grant. On 23 September 2026 the company granted 7,867,865 options over US$0.50 ordinary shares under the HSBC Holdings Savings-Related Share Option Plan (UK) at a GBP 12.17 exercise price, split between 6,525,297 three-year and 1,342,568 five-year tranches, against a GBP 15.146 closing price. No performance conditions or clawback apply per UK tax rules. This is ordinary compensation administration, not a special situation; no deal or arbitrage angle.
